tree.heading: In general
tree.text: There is established in the States of Mississippi and Tennessee the Corinth Unit of the Shiloh National Military Park.

tree.heading: Composition of Unit
tree.text: The Unit shall be comprised of—

children.text: approximately 950 acres, as generally depicted on the Map; and
any additional land that the Secretary determines to be suitable for inclusion in the Unit that—
is under the ownership of a public entity or nonprofit organization; and
has been identified by the Siege and Battle of Corinth National Historic Landmark Study, dated January 8, 1991.

tree.heading: Availability of Map
tree.text: The Map shall be on file and available for public inspection in the office of the Director of the National Park Service.

notes.text: Amendments2007—Subsec. (b)(1). Pub. L. 110–161 added par. (1) and struck out former par. (1) which read as follows: “the tract consisting of approximately 20 acres generally depicted as ‘Battery Robinett Boundary’ on the Map; and”.
